doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Dividend Forecast Revision and Decisions on Share Buyback (Share Acquisition Based on Articles of Incorporation pursuant to Article 459, Paragraph 1 of the Companies Act)
doc_title_jp: 配当予想の修正及び自己株式取得に係る事項の決定に関するお知らせ

key_facts.method: Market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange
key_facts.reason_jp: ROE、ROIC等の資本効率の向上と株主還元の拡充

summary_en: IRISO Electronics authorized acquisition of up to 1,000,000 shares (4.7% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 3.0 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 20, 2026 and October 29, 2027, alongside a dividend adjustment to 100 yen per share for fiscal year ending March 2027.
summary_jp: イリソ電子工業が2026年11月20日～2027年10月29日の期間、上限30億円で発行済株式数の4.7％にあたる最大100万株を市場買付けで取得することを決議。2027年3月期の期末配当を100円に修正。
